standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Reagan opens the pantry wide: 4× Expedition haul, 3× Muscadine Grapes, 1× Foraged food. Giulia, Henry, Meera, Sigrun eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows. For one evening, the pantry is lighter and the people are not. (−2,470 kcal from the pantry) Boris stayed in their tent, feverish.

🍖 The feast is warm and good — full bellies, loud laughter — but no keepsake was channeled. The surge must be armed before a feast can carry it: hold a keepsake and channel first. (Feast buff refused: devotion gate.)

💛 You hold Search locket. The last photo, the one where they're laughing at something off-camera. You'll ask the System what it wants, later. First: them. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."

📺 The Echo. One witness, two tellings. The story of last night, told at dawn and told at noon — and the details moved between tellings. Find what the teller added for the cameras.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

Roman saw something last night at the far traps. Told it twice.

DAWN: "It was big. I heard it breathing. I hid. I don't know what it was."

NOON: "It was BIG — came right at the traps, I stood my ground, it saw me and turned. I think I scared it."
